content: स्नातकः .²1 A Brāhmaṇa who has performed the ceremony of ablution which has to be performed on his finishing his first Āśrama (that of a Brahmachārin); राजस्नातकयोश्चैव स्नातको नृपमानभाक् <ls>Ms. 2. 139</ls>. .²2 A Brāhmaṇa just returned from the house of his preceptor and become an initiated householder (गृहस्थ). .²3 A Brāhmaṇa who is a {%Bhikṣu%} (beggar of alms) for any religious object; नवैतान् स्नातकान् विद्याद् ब्राह्मणान् धर्मभिक्षुकान् <ls>Ms. 11. 2</ls>. .²4 Any man of the first three classes who is an initiated householder.
